tweets.text: Define your loss function on your laptop and execute it remotely on hundreds of GPUs

We just shipped something pretty unique among post-training API providers: end-to-end custom losses.\
\
The objective you define locally gets traced into a graph, compiled and executed efficiently on our GPUs.\
\
Read more about the engineering behind it in our latest blog post. https://t.co/kmg8Q8Ogcs
